title: MLE Agents: Autonomous ML Engineering in Large-scale Recommendation Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.23910v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The typical workflow for improving large-scale ranking and recommendation models is slow and tedious: an engineer forms a hypothesis, implements it as a code change, trains a model, and evaluates it both offline and online, often relying on their own intuition and experience along the way. Autonomous LLM agents promise to speed this up by running the loop on their own, but it is still unclear whether they can do this in industry-scale systems rather than on benchmarks or small proxy tasks. We build human-on-the-loop machine learning engineer (MLE) agents that propose, implement, train, and evaluate model changes on large-scale search rankers. Engineers retain control over objective design, search direction, and final-model review. We identify three obstacles that make this industry setting challenging: feedback takes hours per experiment, offline metrics do not always predict online impact, and improvements saturate after the early wins.

translated_title: MLE智能体：大规模推荐系统中的自主机器学习工程
translated_abstract: 改进大规模排序和推荐模型的典型工作流程缓慢而繁琐：工程师提出假设，将其实现为代码更改，训练模型，并进行离线和在线评估，在此过程中往往依赖自身的直觉和经验。自主LLM智能体有望通过自主运行这一循环来加快速度，但它们能否在工业级系统（而非基准测试或小型代理任务）中做到这一点仍不明确。我们构建了“人在回路监督”的机器学习工程师（MLE）智能体，它们能够在大规模搜索排序器上提出、实现、训练和评估模型更改，同时工程师保留对目标设计、搜索方向和最终模型审查的控制权。我们识别出使这一工业环境具有挑战性的三大障碍：每次实验的反馈需要数小时，离线指标并不总能预测在线效果，以及改进在早期收益之后趋于饱和。
tldr: 该论文构建了在大规模搜索排序系统中自主完成模型改进提出、实现、训练与评估的机器学习工程师（MLE）智能体，并揭示了工业级自动化面临的三大挑战：实验反馈耗时、离线指标难以预测在线效果、改进收益趋于饱和。
en_tdlr: This paper builds machine learning engineer (MLE) agents that autonomously propose, implement, train, and evaluate model improvements on large-scale search rankers, while identifying three key challenges of industrial-scale automation: hours-long experiment feedback, offline metrics' unreliable prediction of online impact, and improvement saturation after early wins.
